question: Which fields does the AlphAI registration form at alphai.io/auth/register take, and must the verification email be confirmed before an API key can be created?
why: The page text exposes only the Google sign-in and a terms line, and the form renders client-side; the privacy page lists email, full name and a hashed password as account data and names a verification email. A read of the rendered form in a browser, without submitting it, would settle the fields. behind a sign-up
